query.description: The inclusive time period to retrieve the data for. Valid values are: MONTH_TO_DATE, for the current calendar month to date; and, PAST_30_DAYS, for the preceding 30 days. If you don't specify a value for this parameter, Amazon Macie provides aggregated usage data for the preceding 30 days.
